text:
Mara Chen: Quick design review for org settings > roles panel. Main pain: rows get extremely tall when users have many roles across projects and datasets. Feels noisy when scanning. Thinking: a compact mode that reduces pill height, enables horizontal wrap with a +N overflow, and makes the Invite CTA sticky to the right.

Joel Patel: I like compact mode. UX question: when +N is clicked, do we show a popover with the full list, or expand the row inline? Popover is less layout-shifty. Sketch: popover anchored to the +N, with keyboard focus trap.

Priya Singh: Popover is better for layout stability. Accessibility: popover must be reachable by keyboard, announce with aria-expanded, and list items should be in a logical order. For screen readers, expose "X additional roles" as text.

Aaron Li: Small engineering note: we can implement overflow using CSS grid + a visually-hidden list for screen readers. But need to ensure focus order matches visual order. Also add an analytics event for overflow_open.

Mara Chen: Good call. For the SSO toggle copy: current label "Enforce SSO" is terse and ambiguous. Options: "Enforce SSO for all members" or keep shorter label and add tooltip. Leaning toward tooltip to avoid wrapping. Tooltip text suggestion: "Enforce SSO for regular org members. Guests are unaffected unless guest SSO is enabled." Thoughts?

Joel Patel: Tooltip + link to doc is clean. We should also indicate in the UI when guest SSO is enabled (a secondary badge).

Priya Singh: Accessibility minor: tooltip must be keyboard accessible (focusable info icon) and the hint text needs at least 14px and 4.5:1 contrast.

Mara Chen: Invite flow CSV import: observed admins get a success toast but no quick way to inspect failed rows. Proposal: include a "View import errors" action in the toast that opens a modal anchored to import results. The modal should list row #, email, and failure reason.

Aaron Li: Backend will return an import_job_id. We can add route /orgs/:org/imports/:id/errors. Minimal response: array of objects. Example: ```[{"row":12,"email":"x@org.com","error":"duplicate"}]``` Frontend can fetch that and show table with copy-to-clipboard for failing emails.

Priya Singh: Also add a CTA in the modal: "Download failures CSV" so admins can fix and re-upload. Ensure keyboard users can access that download button easily.

Joel Patel: On audit log navigation: when you filter and click into a detail, clicking browser back resets filters. Let's persist list state in query params, e.g. ?actor=alice&action=invite&cursor=xyz. That keeps back/forward meaningful.

Mara Chen: Yes, adopt URL-as-source-of-truth for list filters. Priya, can you add that requirement to the console patterns doc? Also ensure focus returns to the previously focused row when closing details.

Priya Singh: Adding it now. Also adding: the "Clear filters" button needs aria-label="Clear filters" and visible focus indicator.

DesignBot: Prototyping tip: 36px pill height, 6px horizontal gap, 8px vertical gap in compact mode. Test with 14px min font and VoiceOver.

Joel Patel: Rollout plan: put compact roles behind a feature flag for Dedicated and Private first. Dogfood internally, measure metrics before enabling for Hosted.

Aaron Li: I'll create a flag: ff_roles_compact_v1. Telemetry: roles_compact_impression, roles_compact_toggle, invite_csv_errors, invite_retry_rate. I'll open infra ticket and wire up metrics.

Mara Chen: Copy tweak: change primary invite button from "Add teammate" to "Invite people" when multi-invite enabled. Less confusing for bulk invites.

Priya Singh: Agree. Also ensure aria-live region announces "N invitations sent" after completion for screen readers.

Mara Chen: Great work. I'll update the spec doc with the compact mode interaction, tooltip copy, import-errors UX, and URL state requirement. Leaving this thread open for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
